links.outcome: Safety and quality scores of LLM laryngeal cancer answers rated by blinded reviewers
links.effect: ChatGPT 3.5 scored highest in safety (mean 2.70) and GQS (3.95); ChatGPT 4.0 2.56 and 3.65; Bard 2.42 and 3.38. About 4.2% of responses fell into the lowest safety category.
links.quote: Analysis revealed that ChatGPT 3.5 scored highest in both safety (mean: 2.70) and GQS (mean: 3.95).

screen.reason: The study evaluates the baseline accuracy, safety, and quality of LLM responses (ChatGPT-3.5, ChatGPT-4, Bard) to simulated laryngeal cancer inquiries without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
